bifrost: springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs (Open-Meteo place search and forecasts only); springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs (GPS formatting only); springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (open a URL, no maps handling)
summary: MapKit covers embedded map views, annotations and overlays, search, geocoding, directions, Look Around and snapshots. BifrOSt has no map view, tiles, annotations, overlays, directions or snapshots, and no SDK map API. The only overlap is text-to-coordinate place search in the Weather app, which uses Open-Meteo rather than Apple services.
